audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Karma, Skill, Zac, Zac, Karma, Zac, Zac while the content whys describe levels 2-5 and first item as even and level 6 as his. Difficulty said TRICKY 7/10 on a 52.17% lane.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Karma, Karma, Skill, Skill, Zac, Skill, Zac, and the mirror audit on zac__karma already established that level 6 is Zac's spike, not Karma's, because Mantra is hers from level 1.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 to Karma, 2/3/5 to Skill, 4 to Zac on both layers; difficulty 5/10, carry threat 6.5/10. This also puts my chart in agreement with the mirror rather than fighting it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys were Karma boilerplate that gave her level 6 and treated the lane as a toll booth she owns.
audit.why: Zac's spikes are level 6 (Let's Bounce! plus a fog-charged Elastic Slingshot flips ganks) and HP items feeding Cell Division sustain. Karma gains nothing at 6.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0..6].why to the blob-sustain pattern and the level-6 flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Elastic Slingshot was described only as 'long-range engage — interrupt the charge or punish the cooldown', with no cooldown and no mention of what it does to Karma's root.
audit.why: The mirror audit established the decisive interaction: Focused Resolve is a 12s tether at 675 range that only roots if the tether survives, and Slingshot's distance (or a line-of-sight break) snaps it so the root never resolves. Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s — at rank 1 that is a genuine 21-second punish window, at rank 5 it is nine.
audit.corrected: Stated the tether-break and both cooldown endpoints in winCon and breakdown.cooldowns, matching the mirror's wording from Karma's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' was a trailing clause and nothing warned against armour.
audit.why: Cell Division heals him off shed chunks and Unstable Matter deals a percentage of max health on a 5s cooldown, so resistances are the wrong answer and Grievous Wounds decides whether poke sticks.
audit.corrected: Put the anti-heal-over-armour rule into breakdown.cooldowns.

notes: Mirror reused rather than re-researched: zac__karma had already established that Focused Resolve is a 12s/675 tether whose root only resolves if the tether survives, and that Slingshot distance or a line-of-sight break blanks it — I restated that from Karma's side and did not contradict it. I dropped the kit's 'grounding' flag on Elastic Slingshot from my text: Riot's description ('attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward') says nothing about grounding enemies, so per the flag-vs-description rule I left it unasserted. Packet suspectNames (Let's Bounce, Unstable Matter, Stretching Strike) are punctuation/plural near-misses of the real names, not fabrications; the only genuinely off one is 'Stretching Strike' for 'Stretching Strikes' in the early text, which I did not have length budget to fix in isolation.
